title: Really useful!
text: Really useful!. Oh boy.  If you have a space at the foot of your bed, or against a window AND you have a few piles of shoes that never seem to fit anywhere, THIS is for you!!  I actually saw this a "skymall" mag while traveling and decided to check reviews of it on Amazon.  It was about 60 bucks cheaper on Amazon AND with Prime shipping!  It is a light colored fabric... wish it was a bit darker, but I just put a fleece blanket on top to protect it. The fabric is a sort of ultra suede feeling polyester fabric. It should wipe clean nicely. Inside it has little "envelope" velcroed all around the inside.  Each envelope holds one shoe, total of 10 pairs, or 20 shoes.  The center is open and you stand boots that aren't too tall in the center... I think I can get about 10 pairs of shorter and medium height boots in.  Or you could store anything you'd like in the center ... extra blanket or two?  Books?  It slides fairly easily on the carpet, but I am thinking about putting some sliders on the legs so that when I change bedding it's easy to slide aside.  Honestly, this is the best piece of furniture I've purchased in quite some time.  It arrived quickly (as I mentioned, I have prime) and in great condition.  I will update if there are any issues.
